sections.principal_risks: principal risks and uncertainties of the group and the main areas of consideration are : NHS Contract Management The group's principal customer is the NHS, embodied in the NHS contracts that the individual practices are required to perform. The main risks associated with NHS contracts are : Non-performance of contract activity leading to reductions in contract values. Poor standards of dental treatments provided by the practices. Poor health and safety standards which may lead to harm of staff or patients. The group has solutions in place designed to mitigate risks including : Weekly and monthly production of management information ensuring constant review of NHS contracts to ensure that budgeted activity is delivered. Development of a 'professional standards committee' of senior dentists to monitor the quality of dentistry provided. Compliance training, regular audit and spot checks are undertaken on a routine basis to ensure practices are compliant with CQC and NHS standards. Funding of growth As the group grows, its working capital requirements will also grow, however, cash flow from operating activities is usually positive due to : NHS contracts being paid in equal monthly instllments at a rate agreed at the start of the year. Private income is paid in advance of treatment. Further capital investment in new equipment is now, for the most part, finance on a hire purchase basis whereby the lender funds up to 80% of the capital value in advance and is then repaid by the group in monthly instalments over 3 to 5 years during the economic life of the asset purchased. Further growth is being funded by loans obtained from bank borrowings. - 1 - REDBRIDGE ASSOCIATES LIMITED
